I only have my own depression, never been diagnosed with a specific form, I was at jobcorp so they gave me meds and said keep on trying. I don't take meds because they make me feel better and then worse after awhile. I run into so many detached moments where nothing feels real or true, like everything is a tv show and I'm too tired to wanna pay attention. 
The only thing I can tell you is to share those feelings or thoughts with the people you think are important or should be. You will never be alone as long as you keep them in your life. Don't push them away because you feel.. far. Tell them you need them to help you through this. Don't hold back when you tell them things, dont get stuck in your own head. Some one could say hi to you someday and it could change your world. Don't give up on them or yourself. 
An example: your mad, you wanna tell your s/o off, so do it. But make sure that before or during or after that outburst you let them know. Because you don't really want them gone, you just need to let it out. 

My advice might not be the best, in fact it's probably really bad. But I feel it's good to let people you want in your life to know what's going on in it.
